items.title: Live: Delta Goodrem lights up stage in 2026 grand final
items.description: Delta Goodrem will perform eighth in the Eurovision grand final, where she is one of the favourites to win. Follow live.

items.title: Aspiration has changed since the Howard era. This budget is finally catching up
items.description: At the turn of the century, "aspiration" described Australians who wanted to put their kids into private school and university, and to build their wealth by getting an investment property or two. Today, it means something humbler; millions of younger Australians simply aspire to own a home one day, to have some shelter.

items.title: Trump is painting DC's reflecting pool. Here's why people are angry
items.description: Donald Trump has chosen a new colour for Washington DC's Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. Here are three reasons why it's proving to be controversial.

items.title: Will drastic NDIS overhaul repeat the mistakes of the past?
items.description: The states are once again on the hook for disability services due to the Commonwealth's drastic NDIS cuts. Can the mistakes of the past be avoided?

items.title: Why some people pay more to avoid convential home loans
items.description: When Wildan decided to buy a property he didn't even consider a conventional loan. Instead, he opted for a niche option that caters to a growing segment of Australia's population.

items.title: Rodrigues thought AI would make him rich. Then everything spiralled
items.description: Rodrigues thought an AI chatbot could help him escape poverty and build wealth. Instead, he became trapped in a spiral of delusion and dependence.

items.title: Top Hamas military leader killed in Israeli air strikes, official confirms
items.description: Izz al-Din al-Haddad is the most senior Hamas official to be killed by Israel since a US-backed ceasefire agreement meant to halt fighting was implemented in October.

items.title: Push to make rental properties ready for portable power future
items.description: A standard power plug for charging your home from an EV is among the measures proposed to improve energy standards for rental properties.

items.title: 'You're malnourished; you are overtrained': Olympic gymnast's warning
items.description: Alexandra Kiroi-Bogatyreva trained up to 10 hours a day, six days a week, often without the proper nutrition. She wants others to know what that can do to the body.

items.title: China quietly turns off supply of world's most used industrial chemical
items.description: Amid disruption from the Iran war, China has banned exports of sulphuric acid, a crucial component used to treat drinking water, refine petroleum and make batteries, clothing and phosphate fertilisers.

items.title: Former UK health minister says he will stand in any contest to replace Starmer
items.description: Former health secretary Wes Streeting, who resigned from cabinet on Thursday in preparation for the challenge, says his party needs a "proper contest" with the best candidates on the field.

items.title: Eight dead and 35 injured after train collides with public bus in Bangkok
items.description: Footage of the incident shows a group of vehicles queuing across a railway line, before a cargo train suddenly ploughs into the side of the bus and pushes it into oncoming traffic.

items.title: 'Don't be a d**k, Dezi!': New claims about Freeman police shooting
items.description: The owner of the Porepunkah property where Dezi Freeman shot two police officers says he rang and spoke to Freeman soon after the shooting.

items.title: Disabled Australians on love, lust and the right to intimacy
items.description: It's a stormy February night in Adelaide, and Jacqueline Tedmanson is at the hospital with her partner Jackson, waiting to meet their first baby.

items.title: Who was still watching Harvey Weinstein almost a decade on from #MeToo?
items.description: Almost a decade after the #MeToo movement began, disgraced producer Harvey Weinstein's latest trial took place in a new climate. But supporters says its significance remains.

items.title: Labor on track to win by-election in Brisbane seat of Stafford
items.description: At the end of counting on Saturday night, there has been a 4.1 per cent swing against Labor after preferences, with additional postal votes still to be counted.

items.title: Artist appointed, axed then reinstated from Venice Biennale triumphs
items.description: Last year, Khaled Sabsabi was appointed, sacked and then reinstated as Australia's representative to the Venice Biennale. Now he opens two installations at the world's most prestigious art exhibition.

items.title: Rochelle Jordan's new album is so good, even she listens to it
items.description: The Canadian singer won widespread acclaim with her third album. Now she brings it to Australia.

items.title: Test your homophones and your Gen Alpha slang
items.description: Are you ready to test your spelling skills like your little lunch depends on it? Come on in.

items.title: How Narendra Modi is turning India into a one-party nation
items.description: How Prime Minister Narendra Modi is turning India into a one-party nation.

items.title: Taylor vows to alter Sex Discrimination Act following 'Tickle v Giggle' ruling
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has vowed to amend the Sex Discrimination Act after the Federal Court upheld a landmark ruling that the exclusion of a transgender woman from a female-only app was discriminatory.

items.title: After her husband's death, Annie discovered he had placed 100 bets a day
items.description: Annie Ashton's husband took his own life after suffering from a gambling addiction. Since then, she's campaigned for stronger regulation of the gambling industry and greater awareness of gambling harm.

items.title: As a child Rob was burnt. As an adult, he’s fighting fire with fire
items.description: Every time farmer and volunteer firefighter Rob Armstrong gets a call to battle a bushfire, something inside says not to do it. But he goes anyway. He knows what it’s like to be trapped in the flames and rescued by volunteers.

items.title: Friends witness 'horrific' shark attack that claimed life of spearfishing mate
items.description: A 38-year-old man had been spearfishing with friends when he was killed in a shark attack off Rottnest Island on Saturday morning.

items.title: Origin hopefuls stand up as Cowboys coach hails 'gritty' win
items.description: Todd Payten said his side's victory over the Roosters was "as good a win as I've had" with the club as Melbourne notched back-to-back wins after a messy 34-8 victory over Parramatta and the Sea Eagles thrash Wests Tigers in Magic Round at Lang Park.
